_comment: Real building: P.S. 24 (X024), BBL 2059170140. Public: LL84 2024 grid kWh (226,605) and on-site solar generated (457,512 kWh), floor area and year built. The intake has no field for existing solar, so it is stated in the question. Not public (stated choices): budget, roof area (floor area / 3 floors), critical loads. Roof area is the form's 'Suggest from city records' answer (sum of building outlines on the tax lot, from NYC building footprints), not a measured roof. Existing solar: 457,512 kWh made in 2024 is from LL84; the 380 kW size is an ESTIMATE (about 1,200 kWh per kW), not public data.
question: How do we cut our grid power another 30% by 2030 on a $400k capital budget?
